import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

class Main {
    static class Node {
        int v, w, rev;
        Node(int v, int w, int rev) {
            this.v = v;
            this.w = w;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class NetworkFlow {
        List<List<Node>> adj;
        int[] lev, edge_tried;
        int st, ed;

        NetworkFlow(int V, int s, int t) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            lev = new int[V];
            edge_tried = new int[V];
            st = s;
            ed = t;
        }

        void setEdge(int u, int v, int fl) {
            int sz1 = adj.get(v).size();
            int sz2 = adj.get(u).size();
            adj.get(u).add(new Node(v, fl, sz1));
            adj.get(v).add(new Node(u, 0, sz2));
        }

        boolean assign_level() {
            Arrays.fill(lev, -1);
            lev[st] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> que = new LinkedList<>();
            que.offer(st);
            while (!que.isEmpty()) {
                int now = que.poll();
                for (Node node : adj.get(now)) {
                    int nxt = node.v;
                    if (lev[nxt] == -1 && node.w != 0) {
                        lev[nxt] = lev[now] + 1;
                        que.offer(nxt);
                    }
                }
            }
            return (lev[ed] != -1);
        }

        int dfs(int now, int fl) {
            if (now == ed)
                return fl;
            for (; edge_tried[now] < adj.get(now).size(); edge_tried[now]++) {
                Node node = adj.get(now).get(edge_tried[now]);
                int nxt = node.v;
                if (lev[nxt] == lev[now] + 1 && node.w != 0) {
                    int nxtflow = dfs(nxt, Math.min(fl, node.w));
                    if (nxtflow > 0) {
                        node.w -= nxtflow;
                        adj.get(nxt).get(node.rev).w += nxtflow;
                        return nxtflow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long dinic() {
            long ret = 0;
            while (assign_level()) {
                Arrays.fill(edge_tried, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int amt = dfs(st, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (amt == 0)
                        break;
                    ret += amt;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static int n, ti;
    static int[] ck = new int[15][15];
    static String[] str = new String[15];
    static String[] es = new String[15];
    static int yy, xx;
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[][][] table = new int[15][15][65];

    public static void go() {
        Queue<int[]> que = new LinkedList<>();
        que.offer(new int[]{yy, xx});
        ck[yy][xx] = 1;
        int lev = 1;
        while (!que.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = que.size();
            for (int ite = 0; ite < sz; ite++) {
                int[] now = que.poll();
                int y = now[0], x = now[1];
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    int ny = y + dy[i];
                    int nx = x + dx[i];
                    if (!(ny >= 0 && ny < n && nx >= 0 && nx < n))
                        continue;
                    if (ck[ny][nx] != 0 || str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y')
                        continue;
                    ck[ny][nx] = lev;
                    que.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
            lev++;
            if (lev > ti)
                lev = ti;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        ti = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            str[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (str[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    yy = i;
                    xx = j;
                }
            }
        }
        // Read and discard two lines as in original code
        br.readLine(); // dummy read
        br.readLine(); // dummy read

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            es[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        go();

        int nodecnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(ck[i], 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = str[i].charAt(j);
                if ('0' <= c && c <= '9') {
                    if (ck[i][j] == 0)
                        ck[i][j] = ti;
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        table[i][j][t] = ++nodecnt;
                    }
                }
                if ('1' <= es[i].charAt(j) && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    table[i][j][ck[i][j]] = ++nodecnt;
                }
            }
        }

        int INF = 1000000000;
        int stNode = 0;
        int edNode = nodecnt + 3;
        NetworkFlow net = new NetworkFlow(nodecnt + 5, stNode, edNode);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = str[i].charAt(j);
                if ('1' <= c && c <= '9') {
                    net.setEdge(stNode, table[i][j][0], c - '0');
                }
                for (int ite = 0; ite < 4; ite++) {
                    int ny = i + dy[ite];
                    int nx = j + dx[ite];
                    if (!(ny >= 0 && ny < n && nx >= 0 && nx < n))
                        continue;
                    if (str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y' || str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Z')
                        continue;
                    for (int t = 0;; t++) {
                        if (table[i][j][t] == 0)
                            break;
                        if (t == ck[i][j] && es[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9')
                            break; // last goal but shouldn't overflow
                        if (table[ny][nx][t + 1] != 0) {
                            net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[ny][nx][t + 1], INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if ('1' <= es[i].charAt(j) && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[i][j][t + 1], INF);
                    }
                    net.setEdge(table[i][j][ck[i][j]], edNode, es[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = net.dinic();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
